description: The Institute of Electronics and Computer Science compiles hardware and software characteristics of Wireless Sensor Network and Internet of Things testbed facilities. The inventory was assembled through a staged review of research published during 2011–2021 and covers facilities described by both scientific and market sources. Zenodo hosts the named dataset as a ZIP archive under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The top-level metadata does not specify the inner table formats or a complete facility count. The inventory can help select test environments and parameter ranges for IoT simulations. Facility availability and equipment can change after the review period, and inclusion is shaped by the literature search criteria. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
